The bluetooth (top) is the membrane keyboard and the PS2 (bottom) is a mechanical. I've tried using both and noticed there are some things I like/dislike about both of them:

Bluetooth membrane:

+Portable (I can pick it up and carry it to my bed, use it with my tablet, etc)

+Makes a lot less noise when typing (people often complain I'm a loud typer so if I use my computer around other people this is a big plus)

+Takes up less space on my desk

+Black colour matches my setup better (black monitors, black computer case, even a gray and black mouse)

-The usual bluetooth issues including dropping after a bit of inactivity or when the batteries are low

-Keyboard tends to slide around sometimes due to its small size

-Doesn't work in computer's BIOS, RAID menu, etc

PS2 Mechanical:

+Never have to worry about batteries, connection issues, etc

+Always works in BIOS, RAID menu and such

+Slightly more erganomic

+I've had this PS2 keyboard for so many years I guess it gets some nostalgia points. I remember playing RuneScape and doing homework with it when I was younger.

+Easier setup, plug it in and it just works.

+/-It's bigger and heavier, good or bad depending on the situation

The only think you have to worry about is again if the bluetooth drops due to inactivity/battery or if you accidentally bump the cord loose somehow.
